Club Brugge are currently without Joel Ordóñez, who enjoyed a standout 2025–26 season and was close to joining Aston Villa in the summer. The Ecuadorian international is managing a foot injury.

Jan Virgili has also been ruled out for the hosts.

Nicolò Tresoldi leads Brugge’s scoring charts in this competition with five goals, including a hat trick at San Siro. He’ll start up top for Ivan Leko’s side on Wednesday, having scored a brace at the weekend. [...] Former West Ham United midfielder Freddie Potts joined the Belgian club in the summer, and the 23-year-old has enjoyed a strong start to the season. Potts was tasked with replacing Aleksandar Stanković in Brugge’s midfield, settling into the role well.

Club Brugge predicted lineup vs. Liverpool (4-2-3-1): Sommer; Sabbe, Spileers, Mechele, Seys; Potts, Vanaken; Forbs, Vetlesen, Lemaréchal; Tresoldi.

## Liverpool Predicted Lineup vs. Club Brugge

Liverpool predicted lineup [...] Long-term absentee Giovanni Leoni is finally back in training after more than a year on the sidelines due to a devastating knee injury. Conor Bradley is also on the comeback trail, but Hugo Ekitiké isn’t expected to recover from his Achilles injury until the new year.

Iraola will surely tinker with his starting lineup from Sunday, with Trey Nyoni likely returning to the engine room and Kostas Tsimikas coming in for Milos Kerkez.
